standing: author interpretation for review; not a mechanized proof
formal_expression:
X=(g,i,k,u,E,C0); D={reuse,specialize,propose,open};
ConformingDefineResult(X,P) iff WellFormedPack(P)
  and PreservesIntentAndGoalLineage(X,P)
  and AccountsForDeclaredConcepts(C0,C(P),P)
  and (delta_P in Functions(C(P),D))
  and RecordsSourceStandingAndGaps(X,P)
  and ReviewableFor(P,u) and NoNewAuthorityFromPreparation(P).
ConformingDefineResult(X,P) does not entail ExhaustiveDiscovery(X),
  ReadyForConsumerAction(P,u), Admitted(Candidates(P)),
  GoalAchieved(g), or MayExecute(u).

notation.X; g,i,k,u,E,C0: Selected input: Goal (with its Project link), originating Intent, context, named consumer plus intended use, exact selected sources/evidence and initial required concept set.
notation.P; C(P); delta_P; D: Resulting Definition Pack, its declared required concept set, its single-valued total disposition function and the four closed handling tags.
notation.WellFormedPack(P): The Pack contract proposed in step 1, exact candidate.3. This remains a coupled candidate dependency until its applicable admission.
notation.PreservesIntentAndGoalLineage: Attributable Intent and Goal are retained; explicit refinements or replacements keep their reasons and prior lineage. No silent satisfaction or lifecycle transition.
notation.AccountsForDeclaredConcepts: All initially required concepts remain handled or have explicit scoped revision evidence. Newly required concepts enter the resulting set; omissions cannot be silently relabeled as completeness.
notation.RecordsSourceStandingAndGaps: Exact selected source standing at capture, ownership routes or gaps, unanswered questions, and affected next uses remain visible; capture is not a perpetual-currentness guarantee.
notation.ReviewableFor: Consumer, use, boundaries, exact references and unresolved obligations are inspectable. This does not mean that the consumer approved the Pack or may act on it.
notation.NoNewAuthorityFromPreparation: Preparing a Pack grants no new semantic admission or action permission; existing admitted meanings retain their separately scoped authority.

candidate_dependency.standing: authored-unadmitted; not an admitted governing source_ref

operational_interpretation: Inspect the selected goal/intent/context and named intended use.
Resolve applicable exact existing meanings within the selected source scope.
Record initial required concepts and attributable additions or revisions.
Produce one matching reuse, specialize, propose or open disposition per resulting required concept.
Keep gaps, source standing, ownership and claim limits inspectable for the named reviewer.
Distinguish an inspectable semantic result from successful consumer work, Goal achievement and owner admission.
failure_boundary: Open semantic questions can be valid Pack content. Missing required structure, provider failure and interruptions without a conforming Pack cannot be reported as a completed capability result.
assurance_obligations: Translate source clauses into a bounded formal model and review interpretation fidelity.
Check all selected current meanings and the Pack dependency under the declared semantic comparison scope.
Keep temporal currentness, authority, exhaustive discovery and empirical outcome clauses explicitly outside any unsupported finite-model claim.
